title: Looking for a SVG/PNG face generator asset library, or to generate one
author: GiLA994
selftext:
Title basically, I'm coding a project that's about managing a sports team, and I need thousands of different faces. To achieve this the obvious idea went around procedurally generated faces through SVG composing, or PNG stacking.

For that tho, I need single SVG for each face feature.

Just as an example, the following project has a generator which uses many SVGs that individually represent a single face feature (shape, eyes, hair, nose...)

Problem is, it's non-commercial, and I'm not yet sure if i'll release for totally free or put some sort of monetization later, so I'm exploring alternatives.

the reference: [https://github.com/ubik23/charactercreator/tree/master/src/layer/male/head\_front\_default](https://github.com/ubik23/charactercreator/tree/master/src/layer/male/head_front_default)

Ideally, I'd generate them with AI but I'm having quite a bit of trouble trying to get consistent results, since the target is to have at least 50ish assets divided into the various categories

Does anybody have any suggestions for my use case? Preferred style is cartoon-realistic (see reference generated by AI), but that's not set in stone

AI generated reference (which is fine, but getting the single components is a pain):

[https://imgur.com/a/tgrjDwZ](https://imgur.com/a/tgrjDwZ)

[https://imgur.com/k4lt0a8](https://imgur.com/k4lt0a8)

comments.author: JP_Sklore
comments.body: Ive successfully achieved this but hit damn it was not easy. The end was a claude to chatgpt api pipeline. Claude maintained the rules and provided templates with style guides to chatgpt. Chstgot would produce the art and then hand back to claude who would remove backgrounds and cut the assets to size. It had about a 70% success rate and still required me to manually edit most assets. Months of testing and tuning before I landed something i considered acceptable.

replies.author: GiLA994
replies.body:
Yea I got to something similar but I just scrapped the thing and started over because I was sure that I was missing something. Guess I'll try again.. my best tries were with Gemini, but it's quite good for prototypes and can't freaking follow directions if I only ask for a part of the face features.

Have you done all this just through the chat interfaces or through some agentic setup?

replies.author: JP_Sklore
replies.body: Oh you absolutely need agentic setups for this.

comments.author: Bal_oney77
comments.body:
hey buddy i made an admin editor thing for this exact use case that spits out svgs with named indexes so users can customize each piece. It is also for a gm game and specifically for headshots. The admin editor allows you to author each individual layer individually and provides tools to ensure they work with all other variants (which is the real hard part). dm me. the game is bball sim -
